{

      "DOM",
      "DOM.Iterable",
      "ES2022"

    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "Bundler",
    "noEmit": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "strict": true,
    "target": "ES2022"
  },
  "include": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "src/**/*.tsx",
    "remotion.config.ts"
  ]
}
